a.addressee: Promoters of critical raw material projects in the Union, third countries and OCTs
Promoters of Strategic Projects and offtakers of strategic raw materials

date_disagreements.a_when: Two years after entry into force of the labelling implementing act; for MRI devices, motor vehicles and category L vehicles from 24 May 2029
date_disagreements.b_when: Two years after the labelling implementing act; 24 May 2029 for MRI devices, motor vehicles and category L vehicles

b_only.benefit_or_duty: Work to moderate the expected increase in Union consumption of critical raw materials below the Art. 44(1) reference projection, through technological progress and resource efficiency.
Continue to meet every requirement under Union, national and international law; Strategic Project recognition changes none of them.
Run an open call with at least four cut-off dates a year and tell applicants within 30 days of the cut-off whether the application is complete.

b_only.addressee: Promoters of proposed Strategic Projects, and the host Member State
b_only.benefit_or_duty: Accept that a single objection by the host Member State ends the application; the Member State must substantiate it before the Board.
Hold the 90-day decision deadline where the application's nature, complexity or size, or the number received, requires longer.

b_only.addressee: Promoters facing withdrawal of Strategic Project recognition
b_only.benefit_or_duty: Before recognition is withdrawn the promoter gets the Commission's reasons, an opportunity to reply, and a reply the Commission must take into account.

b_only.addressee: Member States with more than one point of contact
b_only.benefit_or_duty: Publish a simple accessible website listing every point of contact with its address and electronic contact details, categorised by administrative level and value-chain stage.
Facilitate and coordinate the permit-granting process, provide the Art. 18 information, act as the sole point of contact, and help the promoter understand any administrative matter in the process.

b_only.addressee: Promoters of critical raw material projects
b_only.benefit_or_duty: A promoter can reach the named administrative unit handling its file, and that unit keeps its responsibilities until the promoter has been notified of any change.

b_only.addressee: Member States and their permit-granting authorities
b_only.benefit_or_duty: Accept all permit-granting documents in electronic form.

b_only.addressee: Promoters of critical raw material projects
b_only.benefit_or_duty: Re-run valid studies or re-obtain permits already issued for the same project.
Give applicants easy access to dispute-settlement information and procedures, including alternative dispute resolution where applicable.

b_only.addressee: Promoters of Strategic Projects and all authorities concerned
b_only.benefit_or_duty: Carry the permit-granting process out in the most rapid way Union and national law allow -- a duty on the promoter as much as on the authorities.
Hold the permitting time limits where the project's nature, complexity, location or size requires longer -- six months more for extraction, three for processing or recycling.
Decide within 30 days of the developer submitting the required information whether the Strategic Project needs a full environmental impact assessment.

b_only.addressee: Promoters whose project was already in permitting before recognition
b_only.benefit_or_duty: Request the scoping opinion within 30 days of recognition.

b_only.addressee: National, regional and local planning authorities
b_only.benefit_or_duty: Consider making room for critical raw materials projects in zoning, spatial and land use plans, with priority to built, industrial, brownfield and mined land.
Combine the strategic environmental and habitats assessments for plans making room for critical raw materials projects, covering water bodies and the marine environment.
Publish every permitting decision in an easily understandable form, with all decisions on one project on one website.

b_only.addressee: Member States hosting a Strategic Project
b_only.benefit_or_duty: Take measures to facilitate timely implementation of a Strategic Project, including help with administrative and reporting compliance and with community involvement.
Publish online and centrally the points of contact, the permit-granting and related processes, financing and investment services, funding possibilities, and business support services.
Publish centralised online information on how Strategic Project recognition works and what it is worth.
Draw up and review a national exploration programme covering mineral mapping, geochemical campaigns, geoscientific surveys and reprocessing of existing survey data.
Publish free-access maps of mineral occurrences with UN Framework classification where applicable, and release processed geophysical and geochemical data and large-scale mapping on request.
Publish and keep updated a free-access monitoring dashboard carrying the parameter trends, the supply-risk calculation, and where appropriate mitigation suggestions.
Report new and existing critical raw material projects on the territory, classified under the UN Framework Classification for Resources.
Pass the collated monitoring data to national statistical authorities and Eurostat, and designate the authority responsible for doing so.
Give particular weight, when opining on national stocks, to keeping private operators' incentives to hold their own strategic stocks and manage their own supply-risk exposure.
A large company may take the risk assessment to its own board, with the sources, the risks found and the mitigation planned -- and does not have to unless its Member State requires it.

Set up and operate an open, transparent demand-aggregation system covering unprocessed and processed strategic raw materials, after assessing the competition impact and setting minimum participation volumes with SMEs in mind.

b_only.addressee: Holders and collectors of products and waste with critical raw materials recovery potential
b_only.benefit_or_duty: National circularity programmes may pay for circularity directly -- discounts, monetary rewards or deposit-refund systems for re-use, and for the collection and treatment of waste from products with recovery potential.
Put quantities and concentrations, an assessment of technical and economic recoverability, and the estimation methods used into the study.

b_only.addressee: Operators and owners of closed extractive waste facilities
b_only.benefit_or_duty: Cooperate with the Member State's sampling and characterisation of closed extractive waste facilities where national property, mineral or environmental law prevents the authority acting alone.

b_only.addressee: Anyone placing listed products containing permanent magnets on the market
b_only.benefit_or_duty: Give magnet information at electric-motor level where the magnets sit only in motors, and put the information in the product passport where another Union act requires one.

b_only.addressee: Exhibitors of products incorporating permanent magnets and of critical raw materials
b_only.benefit_or_duty: Non-compliant products and materials may still be shown at trade fairs and demonstrations, provided a visible sign says they are non-compliant and cannot be marketed until they are.

b_only.addressee: Manufacturers, importers and authorised representatives of products covered by this Regulation
b_only.benefit_or_duty: Have an economic operator established in the Union responsible for the product under Art. 4 of Regulation (EU) 2019/1020 before placing it on the market.

b_only.addressee: Economic operators along the critical raw materials value chain
b_only.benefit_or_duty: Supply information beyond what the reporting provisions listed in Art. 45(1) already require.
